whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Lee Martial Art,

I noticed your martial arts academy has exceptional 4.9★ reviews from 600+ students in North Sri Krishna Puri, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for new class inquiries.

Maine aapke academy ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp trial booking, batch timings, aur training gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/leemartialart

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Lee Martial Art Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp trial booking and mobile-first speed for your Patna academy. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact training schedules aur photos integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
